rejected.JAWS_pos: LABEL-DERIVED. It is the mean JAWS of the Hall of Famers at that position as of the scrape, so it is computed FROM the outcome and includes players sitting in our own test folds. It ships as a STRING, which makes it look like a harmless identifier, and JAWS minus JAWS_pos is the most natural-looking normalization available. Admissible as a position identifier, NEVER as a score and NEVER as a normalizer.
rejected.bref_hof_marker_as_of_scrape: A PERFECT LEAK, and not what its name suggests: it is a flag on LOSING rows only. Never join, feature or cross-check on it.
rejected.black_ink: DOES NOT EXIST in this repo. hof_data.war_ink is an in-house metric ranking ONE thing, WAR, hitters and pitchers in one pool per league-season, and it ships as the in-house arm `ink`. Never presented as the public Black Ink.
rejected.gray_ink: DOES NOT EXIST in this repo.
rejected.hall_rating: DOES NOT EXIST in this repo. Prose only.

why_bbwaa_is_primary: label_any's censoring is OUTCOME-DEPENDENT: induction resolves a one immediately while non-induction requires the window close plus the committee horizon, so recent strata contribute positives and no negatives. Its shelf hole is also 21 positives and 0 negatives. Either one on its own would disqualify it from a headline.

frame.predicate: one row per player, resolved label only (notna then == 1.0), inner-joined to the collapsed public shelf, reduced to the complete-case intersection over every arm

drop_accounting.why_refused_if_it_is: every dropped row falls on one side of the outcome, so the hole is perfectly correlated with what is being predicted and the pooled comparison on this label is a statement about a different population

frame.population_note: this is NOT the eligible universe. It is almost exactly the set of players a screening committee already put on a Baseball-Reference ballot page, so an AUC here is discrimination among candidates that committee already advanced.

folds.why_a_block_can_fall_after_the_as_of_yea: label_any resolves at the induction year for an inductee and at the writers' resolution plus the committee horizon for everybody else, and this module's resolution_year uses the next-panel-election rule where the shipped window close does not. A row the shipped label calls resolved today can therefore carry a resolution year in the future. Those rows are scored in the block their resolution year names; the block list is contiguous and an empty window shows as a zero rather than as a missing row.
folds.the_discrimination_leg_fits_nothing: AUC on pooled test predictions of raw scores is identical to AUC on those rows' raw scores. The folds exist for the calibration leg only, and the published bar is on the FULL resolved common-support frame, which is fold-free.

calibration.why_the_pooled_shift_is_published_not_as: Platt is monotone WITHIN a fold. A pooled vector built from many fold-specific maps is not one monotone map, so a correct implementation moves the pooled AUC. The per-fold invariance below is the real guard and the pooled shift is a measured property of fold-map heterogeneity.
